column1: The tour bus, with Polly Carton
A test pattern, drawing on a replay, a still, and the video synth at halftime.
column2: Et testbillede, tegning på en genudsendelse, et stillbillede og videosynthen i pausen.

column1: A stage timer over a picture, held, a presenter view for the person on stage, and a launch.
column2: En scenetimer over et billede, en pause, en visning til personen på scenen og en opsendelse.

column1: A second playlist as a layer, TAKE ALL so two things change on one beat, and a playlist's opacity.
column2: En anden playliste som lag, TAKE ALL til to skift på ét slag og en playlistes opacitet.

column1: The fashion show, with Edda Mod
Polly Carton's tour bus leaves at six, skapi, and this show goes with it. Press START.
column2: Polly Cartons turnébus kører klokken seks, skapi, og dette show skal med. Tryk Start.

column1: A show that travels needs three things first: a check, a fix and a bundle.
column2: Et show på tur skal først have tre ting: et tjek, en rettelse og en samlet pakke.

column1: Honey, I've played four thousand towns. Not one of them had my laptop.
column2: Skat, jeg har sunget i fire tusind byer. Ingen af dem havde min bærbare.

column1: It lists what the show would trip over: missing files, empty cues, outputs it cannot reach.
column2: Den viser showets snubletråde: manglende filer, tomme cues og udgange, det ikke kan nå.

column1: Every show has a problem. Find yours before the audience does.
column2: Ethvert show har et problem. Find dit, før publikum gør det.

column1: The intro video is on the office computer. Select it and delete it, or RELINK it if you have the file.
column2: Introvideoen ligger på kontorets computer. Vælg den og slet den, eller brug RELINK, hvis du har filen.

column1: Fix it here, with time and coffee. Not at the venue, with neither.
column2: Ret det her, med tid og kaffe. På spillestedet mangler du begge dele.

column1: Leave it behind, sugar. I left a whole wig in Tulsa and the show went on.
column2: Lad den ligge, søde. Jeg glemte en hel paryk i Tulsa, og showet fortsatte.

column1: Press BUNDLE and choose where: a USB stick, a shared folder. The show and all its media, in one folder.
column2: Tryk SAMLE og vælg hvor: en USB-nøgle, en delt mappe. Showet og alle dets medier i én mappe.

column1: Pack it like a wig box. Everything inside, nothing loose.
column2: Pak det som en parykæske. Alt indeni, intet løst.

column1: Checked, fixed, bundled. On the other computer, open the show in the bundle and everything is there.
column2: Tjekket, rettet, samlet. Åbn showet i pakken på den anden computer, så er alt der.

column1: The show file is only text, so it travels light. The media is the luggage.
column2: Showfilen er kun tekst, så den rejser let. Medierne er bagagen.

column1: Bus leaves at six. Show starts at eight. Hair takes until seven.
column2: Bussen kører klokken seks. Showet starter klokken otte. Håret er færdigt klokken syv.

column1: There are dozens, and most of them run on the graphics card, so you can stack them.
column2: Der er snesevis, og de fleste kører på grafikkortet, så du kan stable dem.

column1: An effect, a ~ and a colour. The critic is crying. Good crying, I think.
column2: En effekt, en ~ og en farve. Kritikeren græder. Af glæde, tror jeg.

column1: Stack a few more. Order matters: each effect works on the picture the one above it made.
column2: Læg et par stykker mere på. Rækkefølgen tæller: hver effekt arbejder på billedet fra den ovenover.

column1: Three effects! It's a mess! It's ALIVE! Post it.
column2: Tre effekter! Sikke et rod! Det LEVER! Læg det op.

column1: Coach Marv has two minutes of airtime, one replay and a pen, skapi. He will use all three. Press START.
column2: Coach Marv har to minutters sendetid, en genudsendelse og en pen, skapi. Han bruger alle tre. Tryk Start.

column1: Tonight: a test pattern, drawing on the picture, and the video synth.
column2: I aften: et testbillede, tegning på billedet og videosynthen.

column1: Folks, I've watched this play forty times. It's still a play.
column2: Folkens, jeg har set det her angreb fyrre gange. Det er stadig et angreb.

column1: PATTERN adds Pocket Test. If its circles are not round, a screen is stretched. Find out now, not on air.
column2: TESTBILLEDE tilføjer Pocket Test. Er cirklerne ikke runde, er en skærm strakt. Opdag det nu, før du er på.

column1: Its bars and steps are checked against real meters, so a wrong screen looks wrong at once.
column2: Søjlerne og trinene er tjekket med rigtige måleinstrumenter. En forkert skærm ser straks forkert ud.

column1: That's a test pattern. You test with it. That's why they call it that.
column2: Det er et testbillede. Man tester med det. Derfor hedder det det.

column1: Select The replay and TAKE it.
column2: Vælg The replay og tryk TAKE.

column1: A replay loops, so the pundit can talk over it for as long as he likes. He likes.
column2: En genudsendelse kører i løkke, så eksperten kan tale hen over den, så længe han vil. Og det vil han.

column1: Here's number 22. Number 22 has the ball. That's important, because the ball is how you score.
column2: Her er nummer 22. Nummer 22 har bolden. Det er vigtigt, for det er med bolden, man scorer.

column1: The pen goes over the replay, on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Pennen ligger over genudsendelsen på sit eget lag. Tryk på + efter playlistens faner.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the first.
column2: En anden playliste er et lag over den første.

column1: Over it. Not under it. Under it, you can't see it. That's football.
column2: Over. Ikke under. Under kan man ikke se det. Det er fodbold.

column1: The lit tab is where SOURCE puts things. Skip this and the ink lands under the replay.
column2: KILDE lægger tingene på den oplyste fane. Springer du over her, lander blækket under genudsendelsen.

column1: See that tab? Click it. Fundamentals.
column2: Ser du den fane? Klik på den. Grundspillet.

column1: A Draw cue is clear wherever there is no ink, so the replay shows through.
column2: Et Tegning-cue er gennemsigtigt, hvor der ikke er blæk. Der kan man se genudsendelsen igennem.

column1: Give me the pen. I've waited all season for the pen.
column2: Giv mig pennen. Jeg har ventet hele sæsonen på den pen.

column1: Both are live now: the replay underneath, the ink on top.
column2: Nu er begge på: genudsendelsen nederst, blækket øverst.

column1: We're on the air. Nobody touches the pen but me.
column2: Vi sender. Ingen rører pennen undtagen mig.

column1: Press DRAW in the inspector, then circle number 22 on the programme monitor. He is the yellow one.
column2: Tryk Tegning i inspektøren, og slå en cirkel om nummer 22 på programmonitoren. Han er den gule.

column1: A pen's pressure makes the line thicker. A mouse presses at one strength.
column2: Pennens tryk gør stregen tykkere. En mus trykker altid lige hårdt.

column1: Circle him! The yellow one! There's only one yellow one. Circle that one.
column2: En cirkel om ham! Den gule! Der er kun én gul. Den der.

column1: Draw as much as you like. Then SAVE STILL keeps the drawing as a picture with a clear background, in the playlist.
column2: Tegn alt det, du vil. gem stillbillede gemmer bagefter tegningen som et billede med gennemsigtig baggrund i playlisten.

column1: For next week's show. He will want that circle again.
column2: Til næste uges udsendelse. Han vil have den cirkel igen.

column1: Put that in the Hall of Fame. Next to the turducken.
column2: Sæt den i æresgalleriet. Ved siden af kalkunen med and med kylling indeni.

column1: Halftime. Click the Deck 1 tab, then SOURCE, then Video Synth.
column2: Pause. Klik på fanen Deck 1, så KILDE, så Videosynth.

column1: My favourite source: oscillators, mirrors and feedback. A halftime show with no camera at all.
column2: Min yndlingskilde: oscillatorer, spejle og feedback. Et pauseshow helt uden kamera.

column1: Halftime! Somebody get me some lights. And a band. And a sandwich.
column2: Pause! Skaf mig noget lys. Og et orkester. Og en sandwich.

column1: Select the synth and TAKE it. Then look at the monitor: your ink is still up.
column2: Vælg synthen og tryk TAKE. Se så på monitoren: dit blæk er der stadig.

column1: Playlist 2 did not change, so its ink stays over whatever playlist 1 shows. Each playlist changes on its own.
column2: Playliste 2 skiftede ikke, så blækket bliver over alt, hvad playliste 1 viser. Hver playliste skifter for sig.

column1: Leave the circle up. It's a good circle. It goes with everything.
column2: Lad cirklen stå. Det er en god cirkel. Den passer til alt.

column1: A test pattern, a replay, ink on a layer, a still, and halftime. That's the booth.
column2: Testbillede, genudsendelse, blæk på et lag, stillbillede og pause. Det er kommentatorboksen.

column1: Replay in the Draw section draws your lines back the way you drew them. He will love that.
column2: Replay i sektionen Tegning tegner dine streger igen, som du tegnede dem. Det vil han elske.

column1: Same time next week. Bring a bigger pen.
column2: Samme tid i næste uge. Tag en større pen med.

column1: Now THAT is a busy play. I can't see the field. I love it.
column2: DET er et travlt angreb. Jeg kan ikke se banen. Jeg elsker det.

column1: Two projectors overlap, and each fades its edge so the overlap is not twice as bright. Watch the sides of the monitor go soft.
column2: To projektorer overlapper, og hver toner sin kant ned, så overlappet ikke lyser dobbelt så meget. Se monitorens sider blive bløde.

column1: A game show, skapi. Three contestants, one buzzer, and a host who is not here tonight. Press START.
column2: Et gameshow, skapi. Tre deltagere, én buzzer og en vært, som ikke er her i aften. Tryk Start.

column1: Cue numbers, hotkeys, and GO from other machines.
column2: Cue-numre, genvejstaster og GO fra andre maskiner.

column1: Forty years I turned the letters. Tonight they gave me the microphone. Nobody panic.
column2: I fyrre år vendte jeg bogstaver. I aften fik jeg mikrofonen. Ingen panik.

column1: Theatre numbers its cues: Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy reads them all.
column2: Teatret nummererer sine cues: Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy læser dem alle.

column1: Numbers! I know letters. Numbers are letters that went to college.
column2: Tal! Jeg kender bogstaver. Tal er bogstaver med en universitetsgrad.

column1: GOTO crosses a long list faster than scrolling. Much faster.
column2: GOTO kommer gennem en lang liste hurtigere end at rulle. Meget hurtigere.

column1: F1 to F10, F12, or the number pad. Each one is a buzzer.
column2: F1 til F10, F12 eller det numeriske tastatur. Hver tast er en buzzer.

column1: Every contestant gets a buzzer. I get the letters. It's fine. It's fine.
column2: Hver deltager får en buzzer. Jeg får bogstaverne. Det er fint. Det er fint.

column1: No mouse, no list, no looking. Only the key.
column2: Ingen mus, ingen liste, intet kig. Kun tasten.

column1: Buzz! A winner! I've never said that. I've only pointed at it.
column2: Ding! En vinder! Det har jeg aldrig sagt før. Jeg har kun peget på det.

column1: And for our viewers at home: yes, you can push the buttons too.
column2: Og til seerne derhjemme: ja, I må også trykke på knapperne.

column1: Numbers, GOTO, a buzzer, and GO from anywhere. You could host a game show now.
column2: Tal, GOTO, en buzzer og GO fra alle steder. Nu kunne du være vært på et gameshow.

column1: Goodnight, everybody! Tomorrow I go back to the letters. I'll miss you.
column2: Godnat, allesammen! I morgen vender jeg tilbage til bogstaverne. Jeg vil savne jer.

column1: And the number is... not three. I'll allow it. I turn anything.
column2: Og tallet er... ikke tre. Jeg godkender det. Jeg vender hvad som helst.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the map. The lizard stays underneath. For now.
column2: En anden playliste er et lag over kortet. Firbenet bliver nedenunder. Indtil videre.

column1: A Lower Third, a name, a title card, a backdrop. The lizard has left the studio.
column2: Et navneskilt, et navn, et titelkort og en baggrund. Firbenet har forladt studiet.

column1: That's not my name. It's a lovely name. Now, about that lizard...
column2: Det er ikke mit navn. Det er et dejligt navn. Nå, det firben...

column1: A rocket built in a basement, skapi, an inventor who wants cheese, and a dog who does the real work. Press START.
column2: En raket bygget i en kælder, skapi, en opfinder, der vil have ost, og en hund, der gør det rigtige arbejde. Tryk Start.

column1: Stage timers: a countdown over a picture, a hold, and a view for the person on stage.
column2: Scenetimere: nedtælling over et billede, pause og en visning til personen på scenen.

column1: Playlist 2 is selected, over the rocket. SOURCE, then Stage Timer.
column2: Playliste 2 er valgt, over raketten. KILDE, så Stage Timer.

column1: *checks his watch, then the rocket, then his watch*
column2: *ser på sit ur, så raketten, så sit ur*

column1: Select the timer and TAKE it. I have cleared its backdrop, so the rocket shows behind the numbers.
column2: Vælg timeren og tryk TAKE. Jeg har fjernet baggrunden, så raketten ses bag tallene.

column1: Past zero it keeps going and counts the overtime. Very honest. Slightly rude.
column2: Efter nul fortsætter den og tæller overtiden. Meget ærligt. Lidt flabet.

column1: Close MENU, click the Deck 1 tab, then select 'The rocket (lift-off)' and TAKE it.
column2: Luk MENU, klik på fanen Deck 1, vælg 'The rocket (lift-off)' og tryk TAKE.

column1: The clock is on playlist 2, so it stays up while the rocket changes underneath it.
column2: Uret er på playliste 2, så det bliver stående, mens raketten skifter nedenunder.

column1: We have lift-off, Grommet! ...Grommet? Who's flying it?
column2: Vi er lettet, Grommet! ...Grommet? Hvem flyver den?

column1: A countdown, a hold, a pilot's view and a launch. Bring crackers.
column2: En nedtælling, en pause, en pilotvisning og en opsendelse. Tag kiks med.

column1: A magic show, skapi. A trunk, a rubber chicken, and one beat where everything changes at once. Press START.
column2: Et trylleshow, skapi. En kuffert, en gummikylling og ét slag, hvor alt skifter samtidig. Tryk Start.

column1: Two playlists are two layers, and TAKE ALL changes both together. Tonight you will see why that matters.
column2: To playlister er to lag, og TAKE ALL skifter begge sammen. I aften ser du, hvorfor det betyder noget.

column1: The chicken goes on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Kyllingen får sit eget lag. Tryk på + efter playlistens faner.

column1: The lit tab is the playlist that gets the next cue. Its chip now says 'to Out 1': it is layered over playlist 1 on that output.
column2: Den oplyste fane får næste cue. Dens mærke siger nu 'til udg. 1': den ligger over playliste 1 på den udgang.

column1: Turnip Top has put the chicken in playlist 2. In playlist 1, TAKE 'The trunk (open)'. Then in playlist 2, TAKE the chicken.
column2: Turnip Top har lagt kyllingen i playliste 2. Send 'The trunk (open)' med TAKE i playliste 1. Send så kyllingen med TAKE i playliste 2.

column1: The chicken is clear all round, so it covers only itself. Watch the monitor between the two TAKEs.
column2: Rundt om kyllingen er alt gennemsigtigt, så den dækker kun sin egen form. Se på monitoren mellem de to TAKE.

column1: Did you see it? For a moment the trunk was open and empty: two TAKEs are two moments. The trick is reset. Now select the open trunk in playlist 1 and the chicken in playlist 2, then TAKE ALL.
column2: Så du det? Et øjeblik var kufferten åben og tom: to TAKE er to øjeblikke. Tricket er nulstillet. Vælg den åbne kuffert i playliste 1 og kyllingen i playliste 2, så TAKE ALL.

column1: TAKE ALL takes every playlist's selected cue on one beat. No gap, no empty trunk.
column2: TAKE ALL sender hver playlistes valgte cue på ét slag. Intet mellemrum, ingen tom kuffert.

column1: The chicken was late. They saw an empty trunk. In magic we call that a trunk.
column2: Kyllingen kom for sent. De så en tom kuffert. I tryllefaget kalder vi det en kuffert.

column1: Trick two. Drag playlist 2's opacity fader down to nothing. The chicken fades away.
column2: Andet trick. Træk opacitetsfaderen for playliste 2 helt ned. Kyllingen toner væk.

column1: Every playlist has its own opacity. Down is a fade out, with no cue at all.
column2: Hver playliste har sin egen opacitet. Ned er en udtoning, helt uden cue.

column1: Ta-daaa! ...Hold for applause. Hold. Now watch it go.
column2: Ta-daaa! ...Vent på bifald. Vent. Se den nu forsvinde.

column1: Trick three. Bring it back: playlist 2's opacity all the way up.
column2: Tredje trick. Få den tilbage: opaciteten for playliste 2 helt op.

column1: Where did it go? Back in the trunk. Everything goes back in the trunk.
column2: Hvor blev den af? Tilbage i kufferten. Alt skal tilbage i kufferten.

column1: An appearance done wrong, then right, a vanish and a return. Nazdrave.
column2: En forkert fremkomst, så en rigtig, en forsvinding og en tilbagekomst. Nazdrave.

column1: A playlist can also sit on any output. Two layers, a great many tricks.
column2: En playliste kan også ligge på enhver udgang. To lag, en masse tricks.

column1: It's back! Thank you! I'm here all week! The chicken is here forever.
column2: Den er tilbage! Tak! Jeg er her hele ugen! Kyllingen er her for evigt.

column1: A cooking show, skapi. Live. The kitchen is on fire. Press START.
column2: Et madlavningsprogram, skapi. Live. Køkkenet brænder. Tryk Start.
Ta-da! Vi laver stadig mad! ...Det brænder stadig.

column1: Bork! De fire extinguisher is also on fire!
column2: Bork! Brandslukkören brænder også, flördi flördi!

column1: BLACK to hide, PANIC to stop, TAKE to come back. You will survive any kitchen.
column2: sort for at skjule, PANIC for at stoppe, TAKE for at vende tilbage. Så overlever du ethvert køkken.

column1: A fashion show, skapi. One designer, one runway, and a look she will want back. Press START.
column2: Et modeshow, skapi. Én designer, én catwalk og et look, hun vil have tilbage. Tryk Start.

column1: A preset stores a whole look and brings it back with one button.
column2: En forudindstilling gemmer et helt look og henter det tilbage med én knap.

column1: Darling. A look is not a look until you can get it back.
column2: Skat. Et look er ikke et look, før du kan få det tilbage.

column1: Buttons. Good. I design with buttons.
column2: Knapper. Godt. Jeg designer med knapper.

column1: Store it. Before somebody has ideas.
column2: Gem det. Før nogen får idéer.

column1: Close the DASH (Esc), then select Look two and TAKE it.
column2: Luk DASH (Esc), vælg Look two og tryk TAKE.

column1: A cape. On my runway. Someone will trip, darling. Someone always trips.
column2: En kappe. På min catwalk. Nogen snubler, skat. Der er altid nogen, der snubler.

column1: Recall: the whole look comes back at once.
column2: Hent igen: hele looket kommer tilbage på én gang.

column1: Thank you. We will never speak of the cape again.
column2: Tak. Vi taler aldrig om kappen igen.

column1: Simple. Timeless. Recallable. Now go, darling. I have a fitting.
column2: Enkelt. Tidløst. Til at hente igen. Gå nu, skat. Jeg har en prøvning.

column1: Pushes, wipes, iris, dip to white, and more. I wrote half of them. On a Tuesday.
column2: Skub, wipes, iris, via hvid og mere. Jeg skrev halvdelen. På en tirsdag.

column1: A style, a time, and two very dramatic entrances. Roll credits.
column2: En stil, en tid og to meget dramatiske entréer. Kør rulleteksterne.

column1: That is not an iris. ...It is better. I will allow it.
column2: Det er ikke en iris. ...Det er bedre. Jeg tillader det.

column1: An effect, a bend and the patch. The robots approve, I think. Their faces are helmets.
column2: En effekt, en forvrængning og patchen. Robotterne godkender det, tror jeg. Deres ansigter er hjelme.

column1: Waveform, vectorscope, false colour. The scopes settled it. The agents did not.
column2: Bølgeform, vektorskop, falske farver. Målerne afgjorde det. Agenterne gjorde ikke.

column1: Major Tomasina is in orbit, skapi, and her picture has to reach the ground. Press START.
column2: Major Tomasina er i kredsløb, skapi, og hendes billede skal ned på jorden. Tryk Start.

column1: Pictures leave by cable or network: NDI, SDI from a DeckLink card, ST 2110 for broadcast plants.
column2: Billeder sendes via kabel eller netværk: NDI, SDI fra et DeckLink-kort, ST 2110 til tv-anlæg.

column1: Ground control, this is Major Tomasina. Can you see my picture?
column2: Jordkontrol, her er Major Tomasina. Kan I se mit billede?

column1: Every way down, on one page. Good. Space has very few cables.
column2: Alle veje ned på én side. Godt. Rummet har meget få kabler.

column1: Sending now. If nobody answers, I'll just float here.
column2: Jeg sender nu. Hvis ingen svarer, svæver jeg bare her.

column1: Ground control, signing off. Tell my mother I waved.
column2: Jordkontrol, jeg slutter. Sig til min mor, at jeg vinkede.

column1: Ground control can see me! I can see my house from here.
column2: Jordkontrollen kan se mig! Jeg kan se mit hus herfra.

column1: And one more window, showing the clock. Operators who watch a clock are never late.
column2: Og endnu et vindue med uret. Operatører, der holder øje med tiden, kommer aldrig for sent.

column1: The big window is window one, which is usually the programme.
column2: Det store vindue er vindue ét, som normalt er programmet.

column1: Windows, the ... menu, NEXT, the clock, a layout, tally. Mystery solved.
column2: Vinduer, menuen ..., NEXT, uret, et layout, tally. Mysteriet er løst.

column1: How deep the picture is treated as being. The brightness becomes height and is lit from the side.
column2: Hvor dybt billedet opfattes. Lysstyrke bliver til højde og belyses fra siden.

column1: How faint a gradient still registers. High turns the quietest shading into visible structure.
column2: Hvor svag en gradient stadig registreres. Højt gør den svageste skygge til synlig struktur.

column1: How far away. Distance dulls the top and softens the difference between the ears.
column2: Hvor langt væk. Afstand dæmper diskanten og mindsker forskellen mellem ørerne.

column1: How far back each skip jumps, from a stutter to half a second.
column2: Hvor langt hvert spring går tilbage, fra stammen til et halvt sekund.

column1: How far the bright parts pull away from the surface.
column2: Hvor langt de lyse dele løfter sig fra overfladen.

column1: How far the burn spreads off the edge, and how hot its colour runs.
column2: Hvor langt ilden breder sig fra kanten, og hvor varm farven er.

column1: How far the sound throws each line sideways.
column2: Hvor langt lyden kaster hver linje sidelæns.

column1: How far the top comes down as the end approaches. This is not a fade: the level is left alone.
column2: Hvor meget diskanten falder mod slutningen. Det er ikke en udtoning: niveauet er uændret.

column1: How far the two eyes disagree. Brightness is read as nearness.
column2: Hvor meget de to øjne er uenige. Lysstyrke læses som nærhed.

column1: How fast it closes. Slow enough not to chop the ends off words.
column2: Hvor hurtigt det lukker. Langsomt nok til ikke at klippe ordenes endelser.

column1: How fast the drips run. At the left the picture only sags.
column2: Hvor hurtigt dråberne løber. Til venstre synker billedet kun sammen.

column1: How fast the sand travels to the still lines.
column2: Hvor hurtigt sandet bevæger sig til de stille linjer.

column1: How fast the wave travels. Faster spreads further in the same time and interferes more.
column2: Bølgens hastighed. Hurtigere når længere på samme tid og giver mere interferens.

column1: How fast what has dripped hardens away. At the left the drips stay until the cue changes.
column2: Hvor hurtigt det dryppede størkner væk. Til venstre bliver dråberne, indtil cuet skifter.

column1: How fine the water is. Long ocean swell at one end, rain on a puddle at the other.
column2: Vandets finhed. Lange havdønninger i den ene ende, regn på en vandpyt i den anden.

column1: How hard it holds once it is working. Gentle at the bottom, a limiter at the top.
column2: Hvor hårdt det holder, når det virker. Blidt nederst, en limiter øverst.

column1: How irregular the growth is. Low gives an even honeycomb, high gives long shards.
column2: Hvor uregelmæssig væksten er. Lavt giver en jævn bikage, højt lange skår.

column1: How long a short stays closed, in VIDEO FRAMES.
column2: Hvor længe en kortslutning forbliver lukket, i VIDEOBILLEDER.

column1: How long the reaction runs each frame. Short is a stain, long is an organism.
column2: Hvor længe reaktionen kører pr. billede. Kort giver en plet, langt en organisme.

column1: How many places drip: a few big drips at the left, many thin ones at the right.
column2: Antal dryppesteder: få store til venstre, mange tynde til højre.

column1: How many times a skip repeats before the sound catches up again.
column2: Hvor mange gange et spring gentages, før lyden indhenter igen.

column1: How much of the picture glows: only the brightest at the left, nearly everything at the right.
column2: Hvor meget af billedet gløder: kun det lyseste til venstre, næsten alt til højre.

column1: How much of the picture shows behind the lines. None at the left: lines on black.
column2: Hvor meget billede der vises bag linjerne. Intet til venstre: linjer på sort.

column1: How much of the push goes downward rather than sideways.
column2: Hvor meget af skubbet der går nedad frem for sidelæns.

column1: How much the flame gutters frame to frame.
column2: Hvor meget flammen blafrer fra billede til billede.

column1: How wide a band of colours either side of it changes too.
column2: Hvor bredt et farvebånd på begge sider der også ændres.

column1: How bright a pixel has to be to join a run. Lower catches more of the picture and the runs grow longer.
column2: Hvor lys en pixel skal være for at indgå i en række. Lavere fanger mere af billedet og gør rækkerne længere.

column1: How far back the chain listens. The picture is played through a delay, so this is the distance the damage is dragged across.
column2: Hvor langt kæden lytter tilbage. Billedet afspilles gennem en forsinkelse, så dette er afstanden, skaden trækkes over.

column1: How far the colour turns on each trip round the loop. This is the oil-slick: the trail walks through the spectrum instead of fading.
column2: Hvor meget farven drejer pr. omløb. Det giver oliefilmen: sporet vandrer gennem spektret i stedet for at falme.

column1: How far the picture stands out. Bright parts come forward, dark parts stay back. At the left it is flat.
column2: Hvor langt billedet træder frem. Lyse dele kommer frem, mørke bliver tilbage. Til venstre er det fladt.

column1: How far the picture swings the filter. The cue's own brightness opens and closes it, so a cut to black takes the top off the sound.
column2: Hvor meget billedet styrer filteret. Cuets lysstyrke åbner og lukker det, så et klip til sort fjerner diskanten.

column1: How fast it settles away while held. At zero it holds indefinitely, which is what room tone under a held title wants.
column2: Hvor hurtigt det falder til ro under hold. Ved nul holder det uendeligt, passende til rumlyd under en fastholdt titel.

column1: How fast the open slit crosses the picture. Slow smears a long moment across the frame.
column2: Hvor hurtigt den åbne spalte krydser billedet. Langsomt smører et langt øjeblik ud over billedet.

column1: How hard the light gathers where the rays converge. This is the part that makes it read as water rather than as a wobble.
column2: Hvor stærkt lyset samler sig, hvor strålerne mødes. Det får det til at ligne vand frem for vaklen.

column1: How hard the moving parts throw sand. More shake clears the plate faster and makes the lines thinner.
column2: Hvor hårdt de bevægelige dele kaster sand. Mere rysten rydder pladen hurtigere og gør linjerne tyndere.

column1: How long a grain is, in VIDEO FRAMES. On a 23.976 clip one frame is 41.7ms, which is not a musical value and is exactly the point.
column2: Kornets længde i VIDEOBILLEDER. Ved 23.976 varer et billede 41.7ms: ingen musikalsk værdi, og netop det er pointen.

column1: How long before the end it starts. The cue has to have a known length -- an open-ended one has no end to resolve into.
column2: Hvor længe før slutningen det starter. Cuets længde skal være kendt -- et åbent cue har ingen slutning at falde til ro i.

column1: How long it is allowed to run. More steps means the ripples have crossed and reflected more times.
column2: Hvor længe det må køre. Flere trin betyder, at bølgerne har krydset og reflekteret flere gange.

column1: How long the old waves linger when the note changes. Left: they die at once. Right: they slosh for a while.
column2: Hvor længe gamle bølger bliver ved et nodeskift. Venstre: de dør straks. Højre: de skvulper et stykke tid.

column1: How much each facet catches the light, which is what makes them read as faceted rather than as flat blobs.
column2: Hvor meget lys hver facet fanger, så de ligner facetter frem for flade klatter.

column1: How much of the bent picture goes round again. High is where it stops being an echo and starts eating itself.
column2: Hvor meget af det bøjede billede der går rundt igen. Højt holder det op med at være et ekko og æder sig selv.

column1: How much room comes up under it, so the sound settles into the cut instead of being severed.
column2: Hvor meget rumlyd der kommer op under, så lyden falder til ro i klippet i stedet for at blive kappet.

column1: How much the echo is distorted each pass. It compounds, so a little ripples and a lot melts the picture into itself.
column2: Hvor meget ekkoet forvrænges pr. omgang. Det ophobes: lidt giver krusninger, meget smelter billedet ind i sig selv.

column1: How much the material draws in towards each drip, so it runs as a thin neck with a heavier head.
column2: Hvor meget materialet trækkes mod hver dråbe, så det løber som en tynd hals med et tungere hoved.

column1: How often its settings are corrupted. Corrupted far enough it oscillates on its own -- loud, but it cannot run away.
column2: Hvor tit indstillingerne beskadiges. Nok beskadiget svinger det af sig selv -- højt, men uden at løbe løbsk.

column1: How quickly the picture springs back to rest once the driver stops pushing it. Only does anything when memory is up.
column2: Hvor hurtigt billedet springer tilbage til ro, når drivkraften stopper. Virker kun med hukommelsen skruet op.

column1: How quickly the room eats the top end. More damping is a softer, more furnished space.
column2: Hvor hurtigt rummet æder diskanten. Mere dæmpning giver et blødere, mere møbleret rum.

column1: How readily an edge catches. Low sets the whole picture alight, high only the hardest lines.
column2: Hvor let en kant fænger. Lavt antænder hele billedet, højt kun de skarpeste linjer.

column1: How small a cut sets it off. With no picture it runs on a timer instead, and this is how often.
column2: Hvor lille et klip der udløser det. Uden billede bruger det en timer, og dette angiver hvor tit.

column1: How strongly the finished picture pushes the bend. Pair it with a picture effect whose LFO is set to Audio and the two drive each other.
column2: Hvor stærkt det færdige billede driver bøjningen. Par det med en billedeffekt med LFO sat til Lyd, så driver de hinanden.

column1: How wide a view is being compressed. Narrow is a punch down the middle, wide folds the whole frame into the centre.
column2: Hvor bredt et udsyn der komprimeres. Smalt slår gennem midten, bredt folder hele billedet ind mod centrum.

column1: 0 flows ALONG the edges, so colour orbits the shapes. 1 flows across them, which bleeds the picture into itself.
column2: 0 flyder LANGS kanterne, så farven kredser om formerne. 1 flyder på tværs og får billedet til at bløde ind i sig selv.

column1: A command line, as a DASH button runs it. {value} is the knob's number, {note} the key.
column2: En kommandolinje som en DASH-knap kører den. {value} er drejeknappens tal, {note} tangenten.

column1: a note number 0-127, LEARN to take the next note played, or empty for none
column2: nodenummer 0-127, LEARN for næste spillede node, eller tomt for ingen

column1: a video cue's duration comes from its file; still duration applies to stills, patterns and browsers
column2: et videocues varighed kommer fra filen; stillbilledvarighed gælder billeder, testbilleder og browsere

column1: An old deck: the picture wobbles, bends at the top of the frame and carries hum bars.
column2: Et gammelt deck: billedet vakler, bøjer øverst og har brumstriber.

column1: An old tape loses bits of its oxide: dropouts flick white and repeat the line above, and the colour fizzes.
column2: Et gammelt bånd mister oxid: udfald blinker hvidt og gentager linjen ovenover, mens farven syder.

column1: Below the middle narrows toward mono -- which is what a single PA cluster is. Above it widens.
column2: Under midten indsnævres mod mono -- som én PA-klynge. Over midten udvides det.

column1: Blueshift toward the direction of travel and redshift at the rim. Zero leaves the colour alone and it reads as a lens instead.
column2: Blåforskydning i bevægelsesretningen og rødforskydning ved kanten. Nul bevarer farven og ligner en linse.

column1: Bright: bright things drip over the dark, as text and logos do. Whole picture: everything is wax, and the picture itself runs down in its own colours.
column2: Lyst: lyse ting drypper over mørke, som tekst og logoer. Hele billedet: alt er voks, og billedet løber ned i sine egne farver.

column1: Centre is a straight line. Up bends it into an S -- darker shadows, brighter highlights, more contrast. Down flattens it.
column2: Midten er en ret linje. Op bøjer den til et S -- mørkere skygger, lysere højlys, mere kontrast. Ned flader den ud.

column1: Characters across. Fewer means bigger cells and less of the picture surviving, which is usually the point.
column2: Tegn på tværs. Færre giver større celler og mindre bevaret billede, hvilket som regel er meningen.

column1: Characters to build the picture from, darkest first. Empty uses the chosen glyph set.
column2: Tegn til at bygge billedet af, mørkeste først. Tomt bruger det valgte tegnsæt.

column1: Colour is recorded at a fraction of the detail: it smears sideways, lands late and its hue wanders.
column2: Farve optages med en brøkdel af detaljerne: den smøres sidelæns, kommer sent og skifter farvetone.

column1: Copies of copies: none at the left, four at the right. Each one loses more.
column2: Kopier af kopier: ingen til venstre, fire til højre. Hver mister mere.

column1: How much its SIZE becomes distance. Shrink the picture and the sound goes away from you: the top comes off, the image narrows, the level drops.
column2: Hvor meget STØRRELSE bliver til afstand. Krymp billedet, så lyden fjerner sig: diskanten dæmpes, stereobilledet indsnævres, niveauet falder.

column1: How much of the driver's movement the picture KEEPS. At zero it follows the driver frame by frame, which is a twitch. Wind it up and the motion accumulates, so the driver sculpts the picture over time and it holds the pose -- which is what puppetry means.
column2: Hvor meget af drivkraftens bevægelse billedet BEHOLDER. Ved nul følger det billede for billede og rykker. Skru op, så bevægelsen ophobes: drivkraften former billedet over tid, og det holder stillingen -- som dukketeater.

column1: How much of the picture's position on the output is used. A PIP on the left sounds on the left -- and it is a placement, not a pan: the far ear gets the delay and the head shadow too.
column2: Hvor meget billedets position på udgangen bruges. Et PIP til venstre lyder til venstre -- placering, ikke panorering: det fjerne øre får også forsinkelse og hovedskygge.

column1: How much of the tail is kept going while the cue is held. Long enough to hide the splice in room tone, short enough not to smear a rhythm in it.
column2: Hvor meget af halen der fortsætter under hold. Længe nok til at skjule samlingen i rumlyd, kort nok til ikke at udtvære rytmen.

column1: Lift or cut, 12dB either way. The centre is flat, so a band that has just been added does nothing until this is moved.
column2: Hæv eller sænk, 12dB hver vej. Midten er neutral, så et nyt bånd virker først, når dette flyttes.

column1: Light on the drips, as on something wet: a gloss where it faces the light, darker where it curls away.
column2: Lys på dråberne som på noget vådt: glans mod lyset, mørkere hvor det krummer væk.

column1: Line pitch in pixels, so this reads at 4K as well as at 720.
column2: Linjeafstand i pixels, så det kan læses ved både 4K og 720.

column1: One knob for the whole balance: below the middle is darker, above it is brighter.
column2: Én knap til hele balancen: under midten mørkere, over midten lysere.

column1: Pulls the bright tones down without moving pure white, so a hot highlight rolls off instead of clipping.
column2: Sænker lyse toner uden at flytte rent hvidt, så stærke højlys ruller blødt af i stedet for at klippe.

column1: Rotates the reading, so straight lines wind into spirals rather than rings.
column2: Drejer aflæsningen, så rette linjer snor sig til spiraler frem for ringe.

column1: Rows lose sync and repeat one character, the way a real text screen breaks up. At 0 the grid is clean.
column2: Rækker mister synkronisering og gentager ét tegn som en fejlende tekstskærm. Ved 0 er gitteret rent.

column1: The brightness that stays put. Everything above it reaches one way and everything below it the other.
column2: Lysstyrken der bliver stående. Alt over strækker sig én vej, alt under den anden.

column1: The character of the growth: low is waves, then labyrinth, coral, worms, and holes at the top.
column2: Vækstens karakter: lavt er bølger, så labyrint, koral, orme og huller øverst.

column1: The colour it becomes. Shading and brightness stay as they were, so a red shirt turns blue and keeps its folds.
column2: Farven det bliver til. Skygger og lysstyrke bevares, så en rød skjorte bliver blå med folderne intakte.

column1: The distance that sits ON the screen. Either side of it comes forward or falls behind.
column2: Afstanden PÅ skærmen. På hver side kommer det frem eller falder bagud.

column1: The frequency it pivots around -- what counts as 'low' and 'high' for the tilt.
column2: Frekvensen der vippes omkring -- hvad der tæller som 'lavt' og 'højt' for vipningen.

column1: The level below which the source is closed. Set it under the quietest thing you want to hear.
column2: Niveauet hvorunder kilden lukkes. Sæt det under den svageste lyd, du vil høre.

column1: The plugin's first four automatable controls, in its own order. Everything else it has keeps whatever the plugin was left set to.
column2: Pluginets første fire automatiserbare kontroller i dets egen rækkefølge. Resten beholder pluginets sidst valgte indstillinger.

column1: Tints the two directions apart, so light bending one way and the other are different colours instead of both being grey.
column2: Farver de to retninger forskelligt, så lys bøjet hver sin vej får forskellige farver i stedet for begge at være grå.

column1: Turns the strokes across the grain instead of along it, which combs the picture apart rather than smoothing it.
column2: Drejer strøgene på tværs af kornet i stedet for langs det, så billedet kæmmes fra hinanden frem for at glattes.

column1: Turns the whole arrangement, so the fold lines do not sit on the same part of the picture all night.
column2: Drejer hele opstillingen, så foldelinjerne ikke ligger samme sted i billedet hele aftenen.

column1: Two is a mirror, twelve is a snowflake, and they are completely different pictures.
column2: To er et spejl, tolv et snefnug: helt forskellige billeder.

column1: Where highlights fold back through black. Low folds most of the picture, high folds only the brightest.
column2: Hvor højlys folder tilbage gennem sort. Lavt folder det meste af billedet, højt kun det lyseste.

column1: Where the band sits, 30Hz to 16kHz across the travel.
column2: Båndets placering, fra 30Hz til 16kHz over vandringen.

column1: Where the fold sits: the middle at the left, toward the far edge to the right. Flips have no fold.
column2: Foldens placering: midten til venstre, mod den fjerne kant til højre. Spejlinger har ingen fold.

column1: Where the light stands, in degrees around the frame.
column2: Lysets placering i grader rundt om billedet.

column1: Where the source sits around the listener, all the way round. For headphones -- it is a timing and shading trick, not a pan.
column2: Kildens placering hele vejen rundt om lytteren. Til hovedtelefoner -- et trick med timing og skygge, ikke panorering.

column1: Where the top ends, 200Hz to 20kHz. Pull it down to take the harshness off a bright source.
column2: Hvor toppen slutter, 200Hz til 20kHz. Sænk for at fjerne skarpheden fra en lys kilde.

column1: Which channel the curve acts on: all three, then red, green or blue on its own -- the way a colourist warms or cools one end of the picture.
column2: Kurvens kanal: alle tre, så rød, grøn eller blå alene -- som en colorist varmer eller køler den ene ende af billedets toner.

column1: Which way the knife edge lies. Only gradients ACROSS the edge show, so turning it swaps which features appear and which vanish.
column2: Knivsæggens retning. Kun gradienter PÅ TVÆRS vises, så drejning bytter, hvilke træk der vises og forsvinder.

column1: Which way the streak runs: across at the left, upright in the middle, across again at the right.
column2: Stribens retning: på tværs til venstre, lodret i midten, på tværs igen til højre.

column1: Widens the decision into a ramp, so edges keep their shape instead of jagging.
column2: Udvider tærsklen til en rampe, så kanter bevarer formen uden takker.

column1: Zero is one noise value across all three channels, which reads as film. Higher gives each channel its own, which reads as video.
column2: Nul giver samme støjværdi i alle tre kanaler og ligner film. Højere får hver kanal sin egen og ligner video.

column1: BLEND PAIR: expected <other output number> <overlap in pixels>
column2: BLEND PAIR: forventede <other output number> <overlap in pixels>

column1: ASCII WOBBLEMODE: drift | flow (follows luma) | hue (follows colour); no argument cycles
column2: ASCII WOBBLEMODE: drift | flow (følger luma) | hue (følger farve); uden argument skiftes der

column1: ASCII: the selected cue has no text mode (add the TEXT MODE effect, or select a video synth cue)
column2: ASCII: det valgte cue har ingen teksttilstand (tilføj effekten TEXT MODE, eller vælg et videosynthcue)

column1: DASH SET: needs a command -- DASH SET <n> <label> | <command> [| <glyph>]
column2: DASH SET: kræver en kommando -- DASH SET <n> <label> | <command> [| <glyph>]

column1: DRAW COLOUR: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, a name, or 1-8 for the palette
column2: DRAW COLOUR: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, et navn eller 1-8 for paletten

column1: DRAW STROKE: each point is x,y or x,y,pressure, in percent
column2: DRAW STROKE: hvert punkt er x,y eller x,y,pressure, i procent

column1: DRAW TOOL: brush, erase, line, box, oval or fill
column2: DRAW TOOL: brush, erase, line, box, oval eller fill

column1: MASK SET: expected INVERT, X, Y, SCALE, ROTATION, FEATHER, GROW or OPACITY and a number
column2: MASK SET: forventede INVERT, X, Y, SCALE, ROTATION, FEATHER, GROW eller OPACITY og et tal

column1: MASK SHAPE: expected a shape (MASK SHAPES lists them)
column2: MASK SHAPE: forventede en form (MASK SHAPES viser dem)

column1: MULTIVIEW WINDOW <n>: expected a source, or SAFE/METER/LABEL ON|OFF
column2: MULTIVIEW WINDOW <n>: forventede en kilde eller SAFE/METER/LABEL ON|OFF

column1: NEWSHOW: something is live or unsaved -- send NEWSHOW again within 2.5 s
column2: NEWSHOW: noget er live eller ikke gemt -- send NEWSHOW igen inden 2.5 s

column1: NMOS: NOT registering - network is LOCAL ONLY (turn REMOTE ON to publish)
column2: NMOS: registrerer IKKE - netværk KUN LOKALT (REMOTE ON for at publicere)

column1: SCOPES SOURCE: expected PROGRAMME or an output number, 1-
column2: SCOPES SOURCE: forventede PROGRAMME eller et udgangsnummer, 1-

column1: SLICE <n>: CROP, PLACE, CORNER, EDGE, MASK, SOURCE, ROTATE, FLIP, OPACITY, LFO, ON, OFF, LINEAR, PERSPECTIVE or NAME
column2: SLICE <n>: CROP, PLACE, CORNER, EDGE, MASK, SOURCE, ROTATE, FLIP, OPACITY, LFO, ON, OFF, LINEAR, PERSPECTIVE eller NAME

column1: SLICE CORNER: TL, TR, BR or BL, then dx dy in percent of the output
column2: SLICE CORNER: TL, TR, BR eller BL, så dx dy i procent af udgangen

column1: SLICE EDGE: L, R, T or B, then 0-50 (% of the slice)
column2: SLICE EDGE: L, R, T eller B, så 0-50 (% af udsnittet)

column1: SLICE GRID POINT: col row (from 1, on a grid that is on) then dx dy in percent
column2: SLICE GRID POINT: col row (fra 1, på et aktivt gitter), så dx dy i procent

column1: SLICE GRID: <cols> <rows> (2-9), OFF, SMOOTH ON|OFF, or POINT col row dx dy
column2: SLICE GRID: <cols> <rows> (2-9), OFF, SMOOTH ON|OFF eller POINT col row dx dy

column1: SLICE LFO: X, Y, ROTATION or OPACITY, then ON, OFF, SHAPE, RATE, DEPTH...
column2: SLICE LFO: X, Y, ROTATION eller OPACITY, så ON, OFF, SHAPE, RATE, DEPTH...

column1: SLICE ROTATE: IN (the crop) or OUT (the placed picture), then degrees
column2: SLICE ROTATE: IN (beskæringen) eller OUT (det placerede billede), så grader

column1: STING: select a tone cue first (TONECUE makes one)
column2: STING: vælg først et tonecue (TONECUE opretter et)

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT ASSIGN: already on this output, or no such deck or output
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT ASSIGN: allerede på denne udgang, eller deck/udgang findes ikke

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYER: this deck is not on this output, or it is already at that layer
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYER: dette deck er ikke på denne udgang eller allerede på det lag

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYERWARP MODE: linear or perspective
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYERWARP MODE: linear eller perspective

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYERWARP: expected OFF, MODE, or eight numbers clockwise from the top left
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT LAYERWARP: forventede OFF, MODE eller otte tal med uret fra øverst til venstre

column1: VIDEO OUTPUT UNASSIGN: this deck is not on this output, or it is the only thing on it
column2: VIDEO OUTPUT UNASSIGN: dette deck er ikke på denne udgang eller er det eneste på den

column1: WARP SELECT: expected TL, TR, BR, BL or a grid <col> <row>
